components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink-filled mono CTA; cyan fill in dark mode.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--ink, #14171A); color: var(--bg, #FAFAF8); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F5DE0); outline-offset: 2px; } html.dark .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #7FB2FF); color: #08163A; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Outlined secondary action; accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.9rem; padding: 13px 26px; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E3E3DF); background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #14171A); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: var(--accent, #2F5DE0); color: var(--accent, #2F5DE0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F5DE0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Nav CTA
components.css: .ds-nav-cta { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--accent, #2F5DE0); border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2F5DE0); padding: 6px 13px; border-radius: 3px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: var(--accent-soft, #EAF0FF); } .ds-nav-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F5DE0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Surface field with mono uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-field-label { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--muted, #5B6168); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; } .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-sans, Inter, sans-serif); font-size: 1rem; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #E3E3DF); border-radius: 3px; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--ink, #14171A); transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, #2F5DE0); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2F5DE0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Dataplate
components.description: Hero instrument plaque with dashed key/value rows.

narrative.overview:
Light mode reads as a paper engineering print — cool off-white stock, graphite ink, hairline rules. Dark mode is the blueprint itself: deep navy field, cyan traces, dashed instrument rows. The interface behaves like a fabricated plate for a working systems engineer, not a marketing landing page.

Density is deliberate and technical. Mono type carries identity, navigation, and labels; sans carries long-form reading. Corners stay nearly square. Depth comes from borders and tonal surfaces, not shadow stacks. Motion is sparse: a caret blink, a soft scroll reveal, a 1–2px hover lift.
keyCharacteristics: JetBrains Mono as the brand voice; Inter for body prose
Print registration crosses as a quiet desktop signature

rules.name: The One Trace Rule
rules.body: Cobalt/cyan is a signal line, not a theme wash. Keep filled accent surfaces rare (nav CTA border, primary dark button, focus). Prefer ink-on-paper for primary actions in light mode.

rules.name: The Theme Swap Rule
rules.body: Never invent a third palette. Light and dark share the same roles; only the token values change under html.dark.

rules.name: The Mono Authority Rule
rules.body: If it identifies the person, the route, or a machine-readable field, it is mono. Body sans is for sentences, not chrome.

rules.name: The Plate Margin Rule
rules.body: Content never goes edge-to-edge; registration marks and margin breathing room are part of the artifact.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce drop shadows to “finish” a card. If it needs separation, use a hairline or a surface token.

rules.name: The Near-Square Rule
rules.body: Radius stays at 3px. Do not drift toward soft 12–16px product UI corners.

dos: Do treat light and dark as two finishes of the same plate (paper vs blueprint).
Do lead identity with JetBrains Mono and path-style chrome.
Do structure with hairline / dashed rules and surface panels.
Do keep radius at 3px and accent usage scarce.
donts: Don't add soft multi-layer shadows or floating glass cards.
Don't introduce a second accent hue (purple, teal, terracotta) alongside cobalt/cyan.
Don't round corners into modern SaaS softness.
Don't replace mono brand chrome with a display serif or Inter-led nav.
Don't invent testimonials, metrics strips, or decorative illustration as system patterns.
